name: Ambient Light in Bounds
hint: The ambient-light sensor provides meaningful readings from 0 to 100 on Codey and from 0 to 1020 on mBot, supporting reliable control decisions.
instruction: Use the connected robot’s documented limits for thresholds, and validate or constrain inputs before comparing the reading.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB ambient light intensity :: sensing) > (50)> then
say [Bright]
end
